# doctor

Checks node, terminal, keychain, git, network, the relay, your sign-in, the version and the clock. With --cost it reports where a Claude Code session's tokens went and what Centcom adds to each turn (no model call).

```
centcom doctor [--json] [--bundle <file>] [--cost [<transcript>...]]
```

## Options

- `--cost [<transcript>...]`: report token use of recorded Claude Code transcripts, or the launch flags of a Centcom turn when none is named
